maggie: async standup — kernel batching + KV eviction heatmap run

maggie: what I did: kicked off a microburst perf sweep on staging, ran eviction heatmap sim, started a draft of the prefetch experiment doc

maggie: blockers: seeing occasional 200–400ms tails when microbatch ramps from 8->64, unsure if it's kernel scheduling or KV hotlines

maggie: today: triage tail source, post artifacts, and get a quick PR review on the prefetch config change

leo: did microburst sweep earlier, posting quick numbers: p50=11ms p90=62ms p95=118ms (spikes correlate with batch growth) :mag_right:

leo: command used:
```
./run_bench --model=redwood-7b --microbatch=8,16,32,64 --iters=300 --kv-mode=cache
```

leo: attached artifact: s3://rwt-perf/1905/microburst/leo-run-1905.tar.gz (profiles + flamegraphs)

anita: ran eviction heatmap sim with synthetic traffic, saw hotspot at shard 17 where eviction rate jumps after TTL droplets

anita: hypothesis: KV prefetch misses + async eviction racing on same key range -> short-lived latency tail. will instrument lock contention metrics

anita: opened issue #1237 with logs and heap samples, please add reproduction notes if you have them

sara: @maggie @leo quick ping — PR #5123 (prefetch config + small kernel guard) is ready for review. CI green but needs a perf sign-off.

mike: looking now. two quick Qs: (1) does PR change default batch thresholds? (2) are we adding new metrics for eviction contention?

leo: PR changes default backoff window by +10% only, shouldn't affect stable workloads. it does add a metric kv.prefetch_miss_rate and kv.evict_lock_wait_ms

ci-bot: build 1905.321 succeeded for commit abcdef1 — unit tests 128/128 passed. integration tests queued. link: https://ci.redwood.example/1905/abcdef1

infra-bot: rolling kernel v2.14 to staging (canary 10%). No user traffic affected. watch staging-kernels for errors.

sara: taking first pass on #5123, will focus on the metric naming and unit tests. plan to run your artifact, @leo

leo: thx — if you run the artifact, start with `profiles/combined/flame-ram.html` and look at `evict_lock` spans. the flamegraph shows a 30–50ms cluster at 95th for the problematic shard

maggie: thanks everyone. current action items: leo + anita to correlate eviction heatmap with microburst artifact (M), sara to review #5123 (R), mike to triage infra signals if staging roll increases tails (I).

maggie: I'll follow up with a short doc summarizing root-candidate and proposed quick fixes (lower TTL, stagger eviction, tiny kernel backoff). will ping if I need a quick pairing session. :white_check_mark:
